/* REQ: LANG-131 LANG-132 LANG-133 LANG-134 LANG-135 */ @import url("theme.css"); @charset "utf-8"; :root { --accent: #0a84ff; --gap: 1.5rem; } body, .page > main + aside ~ footer { margin: 0 auto !important; font: italic bold 12px/30px Georgia, serif; color: rgb(10 20 30 / 50%); background: url(img/bg.png) no-repeat, var(--accent); width: calc(100% - 2 * var(--gap)); content: "\201C quote \"x\""; transition: opacity .3s ease-in-out, -webkit-transform 0.5s; z-index: -1; } a:hover, a::after, #header .nav li:nth-child(2n+1) { display: inline-block; } @media screen and (max-width: 600px) { .grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }
